blocker_2_xhr_5xx.classification: harness (audit-environment) concurrency defect — not a PR2 application defect
blocker_2_xhr_5xx.root_cause: per-request GLOBAL clock+validator patching in the hermetic audit app is not thread-safe under the threaded server when a page fires parallel XHRs; a transient session-read failure surfaces as a 503 (or, in a different race, a 500) from the auth layer, endpoint-agnostic and equally present on the legacy page (which fires MORE authed XHRs)
blocker_2_xhr_5xx.harness_fix: request-serialization lock in scripts/frontend_audit/app.py (serializes request bodies; threaded server still owns sockets)
blocker_2_xhr_5xx.manifest_hardening: matrix + interaction cells now record per-cell server_errors (same-origin >=500) and failed_requests and FAIL on any same-origin 5xx, so a passing layout can no longer hide a network failure
blocker_2_xhr_5xx.clean_rerun: the previously-failing cell A-today-20__plan_ready__320__tr__nav-on_today-on now passes with empty server_errors/failed_requests/console_errors; zero same-origin 5xx across all 48 cells
